integrity: The three-subspace construction, its distance parameters and distance-optimality are prior work. New contribution is the complete individual-coordinate repair-availability distribution. Prior research comparison is provisional; an older closely related full article was not accessible.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two-helper disjoint repair alternatives in binary punctured simplex codes deleting three pairwise disjoint equal-dimensional subspaces; does not cover larger helper sets or arbitrary erasure patterns.
title: Exact two-helper repair-availability spectra for three-subspace punctured binary simplex codes
